limitations: Four captures per condition supply empirical repeatability only, not statistical significance/error bounds
Weather/calendar control does not freeze dynamic lighting, physics or temporal history
Different stage resolutions/formats prevent treating cross-stage sample deltas as a pure brightness transform
FSR autoExposure/highDynamicRangeInput flags do not expose Skyrim HDR internals or OS Auto HDR
One interior, one upscaling preset, no RS comparison
No performance cost measurement or isolated shader study
